subject: Re: ACME close window — procurement blocking requested shift
messages:
From: Ben Park <ben.park@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Close timing — procurement hold and ask

Hannah / Laura —

Quick update from our side: procurement hit a gating item on the security questionnaire and legal has a new request around data retention language. Our procurement team has paused signature until we get SOC evidence and one small redline resolved; they estimate ~2–3 weeks to clear. I know we’d planned for Aug 20 close but we need to ask whether Redwood can accommodate a short rebaseline to mid-September.

What we need from you ASAP:
- A simple mutual action plan with exact handoffs and expected dates (we need clarity for our steering committee)
- Temporary limits on data retention that align with ACME counsel until legal redline is resolved
- If there are commercial implications (credits/extensions) please indicate now so I can surface it internally

Attaching the procurement timeline they sent.

Regards,
Ben Park
Senior Manager, Procurement
ACME Inc.

Attachment: ACME_PROCUREMENT_TIMELINE.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Park <ben.park@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Close timing — procurement hold and ask

Ben — thanks for the transparency. We can support a short rebaseline; I want to propose a concrete path so ACME can present to its steering committee without ambiguity.

Immediate actions I propose (draft MAP attached):
- Redwood to deliver SOC evidence pack + specific retention options by 8/10
- Legal to review our suggested redline language; target response by 8/12
- Engineering: assign a dedicated solutions lead to triage acceptance criteria and provide a one-week readout starting 8/16
- Commercial: Redwood to propose a one-month credit or extended pilot terms if ACME needs a hold on final signature

I’ve attached a draft MAP and a first-pass slippage risk log (slippage_risk_log.xlsx). Laura / Rishi / Marcus — can you review commitments and confirm which items are doable by the dates above? Ben — if those dates work for you I’ll formalize and share an updated MAP for signature.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_draft_v2.pdf (PDF stub), slippage_risk_log.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

--

Subject: Re: Close timing — procurement hold and ask

Hannah —

I reviewed Ben’s timeline and the attached procurement matrix. Operational mitigation we can put in place:
- SOC evidence pack: we can compile and deliver the SOC artifacts and a short summary by 8/10 (I’ll coordinate with Security)
- Redline: propose the following retention wording as a temporary concession until SOW signature: "ACME data retention default: 90 days; exceptions to be documented in the MAP addendum." Legal has flagged that phrase is acceptable as an interim control
- Acceptance: Marcus can lead a condensed acceptance sprint (8/16–8/20) to surface any blocking issues and provide a go/no-go for the first production milestone

Commercial ask: we should offer a small credit or 1-month pilot extension to offset the friction. I recommend the credit rather than changing list price.

I’ll update the MAP_draft with these commitments and link to the HubSpot record.

Laura Bennett
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Console

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-08T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: ACME procurement hold — recommended concession and rebaseline

Rishi / Marcus — quick exec summary and ask for decision:

Summary:
- ACME procurement has paused signature for 2–3 weeks; they need SOC artifacts and a temporary retention concession
- Proposed internal commitments (see updated MAP_draft_v2.pdf): SOC by 8/10; retention interim wording to satisfy counsel; condensed acceptance sprint 8/16–8/20
- If we agree to a commercial concession, ACME will proceed with final signature once the above items land.

Recommended concession (one-time ask):
- Offer a 1-month credit on first invoice OR extend pilot by 30 days at no additional cost

Decision needed: approval to offer the concession and to lock new close date at 2027-09-15 if ACME timeline holds. We need a yes/no by EOD 8/09 so I can commit to Ben and avoid losing momentum.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v2.pdf, slippage_risk_log.xlsx

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
